items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive for Sunday vs Lions as details finalized. Houston among teams in mix; trade expected post-Sunday games.
items.why: Trade talks finalized enough for inactivity; AZ seeking 1st-round value.
items.implication: No Week 5 production; long-term destination TBD (possible HOU reunion with Stroud).
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson elevated targets/routes in ARI offense.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 5 (hamstring).
items.why: Final Friday injury report designation after DNP practices.
items.implication: Zero Week 5 snaps; Eagles RB committee shifts.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for PHI backups in London game.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Week 5 (left ankle).
items.why: Missed practices; ruled out vs Falcons.
items.implication: Ravens backup QB; flow to Mark Andrews/Isaiah Likely/Zay Flowers changes.
items.opportunity: Elevated TE/WR usage and possible RB goal-line work without Lamar dual-threat.

items.text: Michael Pittman listed OUT; later placed on IR (foot), miss min 4 games.
items.why: Final report then official IR by Schefter.
items.implication: PIT WR depth chart shuffle for extended period.
items.opportunity: Targets to DK Metcalf and others.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN (off final injury report after ankle maintenance).
items.why: Full Friday practice; coach notes maintenance but good to go.
items.opportunity: Projected larger workload than Week 4; clear of Allgeier.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT for Week 5 (quad); second straight miss.
items.implication: Jets RB work to handcuffs/backups vs Browns.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for NYJ RBs behind Hall.

items.text: Stefon Diggs listed OUT for Week 5.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Deebo Samuel and others.

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed OUT for Week 5 (hamstring).
items.implication: PHI WR targets consolidate elsewhere with Barkley also out.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining PHI pass-catchers including Goedert (IN).

items.text: Quentin Johnston listed OUT for Week 5.
items.implication: LAC WR targets to Ladd McConkey (Q) and others.
items.opportunity: Route/target share increase for remaining Chargers WRs.

items.text: Jayden Daniels listed IN; will start Week 5 (elbow brace).
items.why: Upgraded to full participant; coach confirmation.
items.implication: WAS offense returns to Daniels-led attack vs NYG.
items.opportunity: Full QB snaps; boost to McLaurin/Deebo if active.

items.text: Chris Olave and Dallas Goedert listed IN for Week 5.
items.implication: Expected full roles; Olave NO targets, Goedert PHI with Smith/Barkley out.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; expects much better role this week despite ankle maintenance and prior usage criticism. Not on final IR; full-go comments. Tough projection with downside risk of reduced snaps.
items.why: Fan/media pressure on Week 4 usage + off IR + full practice; gut says better role but account for long-year fatigue.
items.implication: RB2 upside vs DET if workload holds.
items.opportunity: Higher carry/snap share expected; clear lead over Allgeier.
items.conflict: Some media notes risk of managed snaps given ankle history and comments.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN (WR8) for volume/RZ and Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10) post-MHJ inactivity; both target hogs vs weak pass Ds. Also likes Christian Watson, Isaiah Likely.
items.why: Usage data + matchups; Wilson volume boost with MHJ out/trade.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; target-gobbler with nickname push (Brown Gobbler). Strong workload/matchup vs soft run D; benefits if Bengals WRs limited.
items.why: Volume + matchup; pie expands with Chase/Higgins Q.
items.opportunity: High snap/target share in favorable game script.
